name: Fuse
tagline: Turn the tiles ahead of the flame and keep the fuse burning.
description: A flame races along a fuse made of tiles. Tap tiles to turn them and line up the path before the flame gets there. T-junctions split the flame for a bigger score but give you more to keep alive. How long can you keep it lit?

build.notes: First playtest build: endless mode with splitting flames and a speed-up over time.

what_to_test.title: Reading ahead
what_to_test.details: Can you tell which tile the flame reaches next and which way to turn it?

what_to_test.title: Pace
what_to_test.details: Does the speed-up feel exciting or unfair? About when does it get too fast?

known_issues: Placeholder art and sound: shapes and synthesized tones only.
Revive and ad-break buttons are stand-ins. No real ads play.
Progress is saved in this browser only.
There are no levels yet, only endless play.
On iPhone, sound stays muted while the silent switch is on.

events.name: fuse.revive
events.description: Tester used the ad stand-in after losing
